last_analysis: All 9 trials scored 0 on every seed, and training success also stayed at 0. That held across every head type (footprint pooling, gather, per-layer, footprint-kernel, 3x3 conv, attention), across depths, and across recipes (1–2 epochs, 140k–400k steps, gamma 0.95–0.99). When nothing learns even on training designs, the cause is probably something every design shares, not capacity. The task warns that the world may not behave as described. Every head so far assumes that action index t*Y*X + y*X + x is the logit at feature cell (y, x). If the world transposes, flips or interleaves this order (cell-major instead of type-major), no spatially equivariant head can learn it. The 3x3 head only covers small shifts. This round tests heads that work under any convention: one sums logit maps over all orientations and both index orders, one adds a fully connected head that can learn any mapping, and one combines both.
